verdict.rationale: Delegating tasks to a built-in agent is Antigravity's core function, and the first-party docs cover it thoroughly. You tell agents what you need in natural language and they work on it autonomously across the editor, terminal and browser. The agent can hand work off to built-in subagents, run parallel agents, run scheduled or background tasks, and work through a plan-and-approve Artifact flow. Community hands-on reports confirm the product ships and its agent and CLI run in practice (one user says the CLI 'works fine'), though one user found the harness subpar. Missing for 10: independent in-depth hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks are completed well end to end.
